description: PARETO is a Python optimisation package for planning produced-water infrastructure in oil and gas operations. The US Department of Energy-supported team documents models for water volumes, treatment selection, facility placement and sizing, beneficial reuse and distribution. A scenario supplies produced-water sources, transport connections, demands, treatment choices, costs and operational limits; outputs are selected infrastructure and water-flow decisions. Spatial extent and planning horizon follow the operator network, not a fixed public dataset. The source and package are free under a custom licence with BSD-style redistribution and non-endorsement conditions, and the provider offers installation instructions and model documentation. The setup also obtains IDAES extensions, so package availability alone does not prove a full solver run. A limitation is that optimised choices depend on private local water quality, cost and regulatory assumptions, which may not be supplied in public examples. It supports water-treatment and reuse capacity planning. The catalogue's model-epa-wmost-watershed-management-optimization-support-tool is a separate watershed planning model for comparison, not a dependency. No network was optimised.
name: PARETO produced-water optimisation framework
